description: What the Illinois HFS OIG Provider Sanctions list covers and how current it is: total rows, counts by action type (Terminated, Barred, Exclusion, Suspended, Voluntary Withdrawal), how many carry an NPI or license number, oldest and newest action date, and the capture date. Use to check the screening data is fresh enough before a compliance decision. Pass year (e.g. 2025) or start_date/end_date to instead COUNT how many sanction actions have an action date in that year or range, counted over the whole list rather than a page, with the count split by action type. The response names the date field counted (action_date, HFS's Action Date). Sourced from the Illinois HFS OIG, keyless.

end_date.description: Inclusive range end, YYYY-MM-DD. Use with start_date for a custom date range instead of a calendar year.

start_date.description: Inclusive range start, YYYY-MM-DD. Use with end_date for a custom date range instead of a calendar year.

year.description: Count records whose date field falls in this calendar year (e.g. 2025), counted over the WHOLE list, not a page. Ignored if start_date/end_date are given.
